title: Heartlake Ripples

outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: A soft blue bodice with a sweetheart neckline, adorned with a large ribbon bow and pearl beading, layered under a sheer white lace capelet with scalloped edges and flared sleeves.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: A flowing floor-length skirt with a shimmering sheer overlay, featuring delicate sequin embroidery and pleated tulle layers, finished with simple silver sandals.
